follow-up time: Duration of surgery and post-operative analgesia
exposure: type of local anesthetic used in subarachnoid block (levobupivacaine vs. bupivacaine)
outcome: time for sensory block to reach T10
time to regression of sensory block by two dermatomes
regression time of sensory block to T12
cohort: 100 women scheduled for elective Cesarean delivery at more than 37 weeks' gestation.
finding: While both levobupivacaine and bupivacaine provided effective anesthesia for elective cesarean section, levobupivacaine provided longer duration of analgesia and was more hemodynamically stable compared to bupivacaine.
